item.title: Man, 65, dies in possible drowning on Hawaiʻi
item.description: The Hawai‘i Police Department is investigating the death of a 65-year-old man who possibly drowned while picking opihi in the Kapoho area.

item.title: UHERO: Gradual recovery for Hawai'i's economy expected
item.description: "Forecast risks remain significant, including trade policy uncertainty, potential additional federal workforce reductions and ongoing weakness in international tourism. While the adoption of artificial intelligence holds promise, Hawaiʻi’s road ahead still looks to be one with slower growth than we have seen in the past.”

item.title: Hilo man, 25, charged with multiple felonies for February thefts
item.description: A 25-year-old Hilo man is facing multiple felony charges after prosecutors say he was linked to a series of burglaries on Feb. 19 at Prince Kuhio Plaza and Long’s Drugs.
